source_string: This device is no longer supported.
translation: Hierdie toestel word nie meer ondersteun nie.

source_string: Our ability to support this device is coming to an end. You will continue to receive updates until March of 2025, when you will receive your final update for this device.%sAfter you receive the final update, you will still be able to play on your worlds, and access Marketplace purchases (including Minecoins). Realms managed with this device will continue to work for 6 months unless they are updated by the Realm owner on a different device.%sTo cancel your Realm subscription, you will need to do so in the Settings menu for Subscriptions on the device the Realm was created with.%sYou will no longer receive the latest updates and will be unable to play multiplayer with devices or Realms which are continuing to receive updates. You will also not be able to connect to certain servers.%sClick on the button for more information.
translation: Ons vermoë om hierdie toestel te ondersteun, kom tot 'n einde. Jy sal steeds opdaterings ontvang tot Maart 2025, wanneer jy jou finale opdatering vir hierdie toestel sal ontvang.%sNadat jy die finale opdatering ontvang het, sal jy nog op jou wêrelde kan speel, en toegang tot Marketplace-aankope hê (insluitend Minecoins). Realms wat met hierdie toestel bestuur word, sal 6 maande lank aanbly werk, tensy dit deur die Realm-eienaar op 'n ander toestel opgedateer word.%sOm jou Realm-inskrywing te kanselleer, moet jy dit doen in die Verstellings-kieslys vir Inskrywings op die toestel waarmee die Realm geskep is.%sJy sal nie meer die nuutste opdaterings ontvang nie en sal nie multispeler kan speel met toestelle of Realms wat steeds opdaterings ontvang nie. Jy sal ook nie met sekere bedieners kan verbind nie.%sKlik op die knoppie vir meer inligting.

source_string: Our ability to support this device has come to an end. You will no longer receive updates as of March of 2025, and this is your final update for this device.%sYou will still be able to play on your worlds, and access Marketplace purchases (including Minecoins). Realms managed with this device will continue to work for 6 months from March of 2025 unless they are updated by the Realm owner on a different device.%sTo cancel your Realm subscription, you will need to do so in the Settings menu for Subscriptions on the device the Realm was created with.%sYou will no longer receive the latest updates and will be unable to play multiplayer with devices or Realms which are continuing to receive updates. You will also not be able to connect to certain servers.%sClick on the button for more information.
translation: Ons vermoë om hierdie toestel te ondersteun, het tot 'n einde gekom. Jy sal nie meer opdaterings ontvang vanaf Maart 2025 nie, en dit is jou finale opdatering vir hierdie toestel.%sJy sal nog op jou wêrelde kan speel, en toegang tot Marketplace-aankope hê (insluitend Minecoins). Realms wat met hierdie toestel bestuur word, sal 6 maande vanaf Maart 2025 aanbly werk, tensy dit deur die Realm-eienaar op 'n ander toestel opgedateer word.%sOm jou Realm-inskrywing te kanselleer, moet jy dit doen in die Verstellings-kieslys vir Inskrywings op die toestel waarmee die Realm geskep is.%sJy sal nie meer die nuutste opdaterings ontvang nie en sal nie multispeler kan speel met toestelle of Realms wat steeds opdaterings ontvang nie. Jy sal ook nie met sekere bedieners kan verbind nie.%sKlik op die knoppie vir meer inligting.

source_string: Our ability to support this VR/MR graphic device has come to an end. This device will no longer be supported in updates after March of 2025, when you will receive your final update supporting this device.%sAfter you receive the final update, you will still receive updates on your PC and be able to play without a VR/MR device. From this point on you can keep building in your worlds, and your Marketplace purchases (including Minecoins) will continue to be available on a non-VR/MR graphics devices such as a computer monitor. You will no longer be able to use your VR/MR device with Minecraft as it will no longer be supported in the latest updates.%sClick on the button for more information.
translation: Ons vermoë om hierdie VR/MR-grafiese toestel te ondersteun, het tot 'n einde gekom. Hierdie toestel sal nie meer ondersteun word in opdaterings na Maart 2025 nie, wanneer jy jou finale opdatering wat hierdie toestel ondersteun, sal ontvang.%sNadat jy die finale opdatering ontvang het, sal jy nog opdaterings op jou rekenaar ontvang en sonder 'n VR/MR-toestel kan speel. Vanaf hierdie punt kan jy voortgaan om in jou wêrelde te bou, en jou Marketplace-aankope (insluitend Minecoins) sal beskikbaar bly op nie-VR/MR-grafikatoestelle soos 'n rekenaarskerm. Jy sal nie meer jou VR/MR-toestel met Minecraft kan gebruik nie, want dit sal nie meer ondersteun word in die nuutste opdaterings nie.%sKlik op die knoppie vir meer inligting.

source_string: Our ability to support this VR/MR graphic device has come to an end. This VR/MR device is no longer supported. You have received the final update supporting this graphics device, and you will still receive updates on your PC and be able to play without a VR/MR device. From this point on you can keep building in your worlds, and your Marketplace purchases (including Minecoins) will continue to be available on a non-VR/MR graphics devices such as a computer monitor. You will no longer be able to use your VR/MR device with Minecraft as it will no longer be supported in the latest updates.%sClick on the button for more information. We know this is an inconvenience, and deeply appreciate the time you spent with our game, and your support.
translation: Ons vermoë om hierdie VR/MR-grafiese toestel te ondersteun, het tot 'n einde gekom. Hierdie VR/MR-toestel word nie meer ondersteun nie. Jy het die finale opdatering wat hierdie grafikatoestel ondersteun, ontvang, en jy sal nog opdaterings op jou rekenaar ontvang en sonder 'n VR/MR-toestel kan speel. Vanaf hierdie punt kan jy voortgaan om in jou wêrelde te bou, en jou Marketplace-aankope (insluitend Minecoins) sal beskikbaar bly op nie-VR/MR-grafikatoestelle soos 'n rekenaarskerm. Jy sal nie meer jou VR/MR-toestel met Minecraft kan gebruik nie, want dit sal nie meer ondersteun word in die nuutste opdaterings nie.%sKlik op die knoppie vir meer inligting. Ons weet dit is ongerieflik, en waardeer jou tyd met ons spel en jou ondersteuning ten diepste.

translation: Jy kan nie met ander spelers klets nie as gevolg van hoe jou Microsoft-rekening opgestel is. Maak asseblief seker jou privaatheidsverstellings laat kommunikasie met ander toe. Sien instruksies om hierdie verstellings te verander by aka.ms/MCMultiplayerHelp.

source_string: You will not be able to add new friends to play on your realm with you because of how your Xbox account is set up. This can be changed in your privacy & online safety settings on Xbox.com. Do you want to continue?
translation: Jy sal nie nuwe vriende kan byvoeg om saam met jou op jou realm te speel nie, as gevolg van hoe jou Xbox-rekening opgestel is. Dit kan verander word in jou privaatheid & aanlynveiligheidsverstellings op Xbox.com. Wil jy voortgaan?

source_string: You cannot save your worlds to your Xbox profile because of how your account is set up. This can be changed in your privacy & online safety settings on Xbox.com.
translation: Jy kan nie jou wêrelde na jou Xbox-profiel stoor nie as gevolg van hoe jou rekening opgestel is. Dit kan verander word in jou privaatheid & aanlynveiligheidsverstellings op Xbox.com.

source_string: You cannot play on Realms because of how your Microsoft account is set up. Please ensure your online safety settings allow Multiplayer and you have an active Xbox Live Gold subscription. See instructions for changing these settings at aka.ms/MCMultiplayerHelp.
translation: Jy kan nie op Realms speel nie as gevolg van hoe jou Microsoft-rekening opgestel is. Maak asseblief seker jou aanlynveiligheidsverstellings laat Multispeler toe en dat jy 'n aktiewe Xbox Live Gold-inskrywing het. Sien instruksies om hierdie verstellings te verander by aka.ms/MCMultiplayerHelp.

source_string: You cannot play on Realms because of how your Microsoft account is set up.
translation: Jy kan nie op Realms speel nie as gevolg van hoe jou Microsoft-rekening opgestel is.
Kry hulp om dit reg te maak

source_string: They will no longer have Operator level permissions by lowering their permission level.
translation: Hulle sal nie meer Operateur-vlak toestemmings hê nie deur hulle toestemmingsvlak te verlaag.

source_string: Visitors can freely explore your world, but cannot interact with blocks, items, or entities. Trust Players Off.
translation: Besoekers kan vrylik jou wêreld verken, maar kan nie met blokke, items, of entiteite interaksie hê nie. Vertrou Spelers Af.

source_string: Members are active players in your world who can break and create blocks, and attack mobs and other players.
translation: Lede is aktiewe spelers in jou wêreld wat blokke kan breek en skep, en mobs en ander spelers kan aanval.

source_string: Operators are members who can set player permissions and use commands to have more control over your world.
translation: Operateurs is lede wat spelertoestemmings kan stel en opdragte kan gebruik om meer beheer oor jou wêreld te hê.

source_string: Certain commands like teleport are only available with cheats ON. Cheats can also be turned on through the Game menu under Game Settings. If you choose to turn cheats on, achievements will be disabled in this world.
translation: Sekere opdragte soos teleportasie is slegs beskikbaar met kullery AAN. Kullery kan ook aangeskakel word deur die spelkieslys onder Spelverstellings. As jy kies om kullery aan te skakel, sal prestasies in hierdie wêreld gedeaktiveer word.

source_string: Certain commands like teleport are only available with cheats ON. Cheats can also be turned on through the Game menu under Game Settings.
translation: Sekere opdragte soos teleportasie is slegs beskikbaar met kullery AAN. Kullery kan ook aangeskakel word deur die spelkieslys onder Spelverstellings.

source_string: You will no longer have Operator level permissions by lowering your permission level.
translation: Jy sal nie meer Operateur-vlak toestemmings hê nie deur jou toestemmingsvlak te verlaag.

source_string: Player permission when joining from invite
Permission level for players who join your world
translation: Toestemmingsvlak vir spelers wat by jou wêreld aansluit
'n Speler het by die spel aangesluit.

source_string: You have been kicked from the session by the host.
translation: Jy is deur die gasheer uit die sessie geskop.

source_string: Are you sure you want to kick %s from the world? They will not be able to rejoin this session.
translation: Is jy seker jy wil %s uit die wêreld skop? Hulle sal nie hierdie sessie weer kan aansluit nie.

source_string: Are you sure you want to kick %s from the world?
translation: Is jy seker jy wil %s uit die wêreld skop?

source_string: You have been banned from the session by the host.
translation: Jy is deur die gasheer van die sessie verban.

source_string: Are you sure you want to ban %s from the world? They will not be able to rejoin.
translation: Is jy seker jy wil %s uit die wêreld verban? Hulle sal nie kan weer aansluit nie.

source_string: You cannot access the Realms Feed because you do not have access to Clubs. See instructions for changing these settings at aka.ms/MCClubsHelp.
translation: Jy het geen toegang tot die Realms-voer nie omdat jy geen toegang tot Clubs het nie. Sien instruksies om hierdie verstellings te verander by aka.ms/MCClubsHelp.

source_string: You cannot post to the Realms Feed because you do not have access to Clubs. See instructions for changing these settings at aka.ms/MCClubsHelp.
translation: Jy kan nie na die Realms-voer plaas nie omdat jy geen toegang tot Clubs het nie. Sien instruksies om hierdie verstellings te verander by aka.ms/MCClubsHelp.

source_string: You have been removed from the session by the host.
translation: Jy is deur die gasheer van die sessie verwyder.

source_string: Are you sure you want to remove this player from the world? When you remove this player a new join code will be generated so that they will not be able to rejoin.
translation: Is jy seker jy wil hierdie speler uit die wêreld verwyder? Wanneer jy hierdie speler verwyder, sal 'n nuwe aansluitkode gegenereer word sodat hulle nie kan weer aansluit nie.

source_string: You currently have no photos in your portfolio. Photos taken with the camera will show up here. You can also use the button below to add some.
translation: Jy het tans geen foto's in jou portefeulje nie. Foto's geneem met die kamera sal hier verskyn. Jy kan ook die knoppie hieronder gebruik om sommige by te voeg.

source_string: Photos you take with the camera will show up here.
translation: Foto's wat jy met die kamera neem, sal hier verskyn.

source_string: You do not have any photos in your inventory. Try using the camera to take a picture.
translation: Jy het geen foto's in jou inventaris nie. Probeer die kamera gebruik om 'n foto te neem.

source_string: Splash Potion of the Turtle Master
translation: Spat Doepa van die Skilpad Meester

source_string: Lingering Potion of the Turtle Master
translation: Voortslepende doepa van die skilpad Meester

source_string: Differences between Character Creator and Classic Skins
translation: Verskille tussen karakterskepper en klassieke velle

source_string: You make a custom character in Minecraft item by item.
translation: Jy maak 'n pasgemaakte karakter in Minecraft item vir item.

source_string: Create a custom character in Minecraft piece by piece. Personalize your character's body, eyes, mouth, hairstyles, clothing, and more!
translation: Skep 'n pasgemaakte karakter in Minecraft stuk vir stuk. Personaliseer jou karakter se lyf, oë, mond, haarstyle, klere, en meer!

source_string: A full body skin that is placed on the character. Classic skins cannot be modified piece by piece. You can also import your own full body skin that you created or downloaded.
translation: 'n Volle-liggaam-vel wat op die karakter geplaas word. Klassieke velle kan nie stuk-vir-stuk verander word nie. Jy kan ook jou eie volle-liggaam-vel invoer wat jy geskep of afgelaai het.

source_string: A whole-body skin texture that is placed onto a character.
translation: 'n Heel-liggaam vel-textuur wat op 'n karakter geplaas word.

source_string: You save %s minecoins with your Realms Plus subscription!
translation: Jy spaar %s minecoins met jou Realms Plus-inskrywing!

source_string: You save %s minecoins with your Marketplace Pass subscription!
translation: Jy spaar %s minecoins met jou Marketplace Pass-inskrywing!

source_string: Unable to connect to the world. Please check your connection to the internet and try again.
translation: Kan nie met die wêreld verbind nie. Kontroleer asseblief jou internetverbinding en probeer weer.

source_string: Appearance is taking a long time to load. Proceeding with world generation...
translation: Voorkoms neem lank om te laai. Gaan voort met wêreldgenerasie...

source_string: This may take a few minutes.
Please do not exit the game. Exiting might corrupt the export.
translation: Verlaat asseblief nie die spel nie. Verlaat mag die uitvoer korrup maak.

source_string: This may take a few moments
This may take a few moments...
This may take a few moments
World upload failed. Would you like to try again?
translation: Wêreldoplaai het gefaal. Wil jy weer probeer?

source_string: Invalid world file. Please reopen your world, save, then try again.
translation: Ongeldige wêreldlêer. Maak asseblief jou wêreld weer oop, stoor, en probeer weer.

source_string: Your game is being saved. Please do not turn off your device.
translation: Jou spel word tans gestoor. Skakel asseblief nie jou toestel af nie.

source_string: This may take a few moments
We couldn't confirm if your world uploaded properly. Please join your Realm to check, then try again if it hasn't been updated to the new world.
translation: Ons kon nie bevestig of jou wêreld behoorlik opgelaai is nie. Sluit asseblief by jou Realm aan om te kontroleer, en probeer weer as dit nie na die nuwe wêreld opgedateer is nie.

source_string: Failed to find a place to upload your world. Maybe check your internet connection?
translation: Kon nie 'n plek vind om jou wêreld op te laai nie. Kontroleer miskien jou internetverbinding?

source_string: It looks like you do not own the Marketplace template this world is based on. You can purchase it from Minecraft Marketplace.
translation: Dit lyk of jy nie die Marketplace-sjabloon waarop hierdie wêreld gebaseer is, besit nie. Jy kan dit koop van Minecraft Marketplace.

source_string: We couldn't pack your world file for upload. Maybe your hard drive is full?
translation: Ons kon nie jou wêreldlêer vir oplaai verpak nie. Is jou hardeskyf dalk vol?

source_string: Something went wrong while preparing to upload your world. If this keeps happening, restarting your device may help.
translation: Iets het verkeerd geloop tydens die voorbereiding om jou wêreld op te laai. As dit voortgaan, kan herbegin van jou toestel help.

source_string: This world can't be opened because of a directory issue in the pack.
translation: Hierdie wêreld kan nie oopgemaak word nie as gevolg van 'n gidsprobleem in die pak.

source_string: You do not own one or more of the applied packs
translation: Jy besit nie een of meer van die toegepaste pakke nie

source_string: The world name contains words that others may find offensive and cannot be used.
translation: Die wêreldnaam bevat woorde wat ander aanstootlik kan vind en kan nie gebruik word nie.

source_string: You're playing in a world with Add-Ons! This will add new features to your Minecraft world.
translation: Jy speel in 'n wêreld met Add-Ons! Dit sal nuwe funksies by jou Minecraft-wêreld byvoeg.

source_string: Don't stop with just one! You can load multiple Add-Ons onto a single world at once.
translation: Moenie by net een bly nie! Jy kan verskeie Add-Ons op een slag op een wêreld laai.

source_string: Advanced Tip: A Resource Pack can change the textures of different blocks and entities.
translation: Gevorderde wenk: 'n Hulpbronpak kan die teksture van verskillende blokke en entiteite verander.

source_string: Advanced Tip: A Behavior Pack can change how different items, entities, or blocks work.
translation: Gevorderde wenk: 'n Gedragspak kan verander hoe verskillende items, entiteite, of blokke werk.

source_string: Advanced Tip: An Add-On includes both a Behavior Pack and a Resource Pack. Make sure both packs are activated to ensure the Add-On works!
translation: Gevorderde wenk: 'n Add-On sluit sowel 'n Gedragspak as 'n Hulpbronpak in. Maak seker beide pakke is geaktiveer om te verseker dat die Add-On werk!

source_string: Add-Ons add new blocks, items, or mobs to your worlds.
translation: Add-Ons voeg nuwe blokke, items, of mobs by jou wêrelde.

source_string: Worlds and Add-ons are complex! While some work great together, you might get funky results with others.
translation: Wêrelde en Add-Ons is kompleks! Terwyl sommige goed saamwerk, mag jy vreemde resultate met ander kry.

source_string: More Add-Ons mean more fun, but the game might take longer to load.
translation: Meer Add-Ons beteken meer pret, maar die spel mag langer neem om te laai.

source_string: Some optional resource packs applied to this world include ray tracing. Your device is not compatible with advanced lighting and texture features so you will see the world without these advanced effects.
translation: Sommige opsionele hulpbronpakke wat op hierdie wêreld toegepas is, sluit straalvolging in. Jou toestel is nie versoenbaar met gevorderde beligting- en textuurfunksies nie, so jy sal die wêreld sonder hierdie gevorderde effekte sien.

source_string: Some optional and required resource packs applied to this world include ray tracing. Your device is not compatible with advanced lighting and texture features so you will see the world without these advanced effects.
translation: Sommige opsionele en verpligte hulpbronpakke wat op hierdie wêreld toegepas is, sluit straalvolging in. Jou toestel is nie versoenbaar met gevorderde beligting- en textuurfunksies nie, so jy sal die wêreld sonder hierdie gevorderde effekte sien.

source_string: Some required resource packs applied to this world include ray tracing. Your device is not compatible with advanced lighting and texture features so you will see the world without these advanced effects.
translation: Sommige verpligte hulpbronpakke wat op hierdie wêreld toegepas is, sluit straalvolging in. Jou toestel is nie versoenbaar met gevorderde beligting- en textuurfunksies nie, so jy sal die wêreld sonder hierdie gevorderde effekte sien.

source_string: This world has optional Resource Packs applied to it. Would you like to download them before you join?
translation: Hierdie wêreld het opsionele Hulpbronpakke daarop toegepas. Wil jy dit aflaai voordat jy aansluit?

source_string: This world has optional Resource Packs and required Resource Packs from Add-Ons applied to it. Would you like to download all packs or only the ones required to join?
translation: Hierdie wêreld het opsionele Hulpbronpakke en verpligte Hulpbronpakke van Add-Ons daarop toegepas. Wil jy alle pakke aflaai of slegs dié wat nodig is om aan te sluit?

source_string: This world has required Resource Packs from Add-Ons applied to it. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Hierdie wêreld het verpligte Hulpbronpakke van Add-Ons daarop toegepas. Wil jy dit aflaai en aansluit?

source_string: The owner of this world requires players to download all Resource Packs applied to it. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Die eienaar van hierdie wêreld vereis dat spelers alle Hulpbronpakke wat daarop toegepas is, aflaai. Wil jy dit aflaai en aansluit?

source_string: Could not sync your world data. Would you like to try again?
translation: Kon nie jou wêrelddata sinkroniseer nie. Wil jy weer probeer?

source_string: The world is not fully synced or has been corrupted. Try playing the world on a console where it's in a good state and try migrating it again.
translation: Die wêreld is nie volledig gesinkroniseer nie of is korrup. Probeer die wêreld op 'n konsole speel waar dit in 'n goeie toestand is en probeer weer migreer.

source_string: Local save successful but cloud sync failed due to quota. Free cloud space by deleting worlds from the settings menu.
translation: Plaaslike stoor was suksesvol maar wolksinkronisasie het gefaal weens kwota. Maak wolkspasie vry deur wêrelde te verwyder vanaf die verstellings-kieslys.

source_string: Not enough local free space to support cloud sync.
translation: Nie genoeg plaaslike vrye spasie om wolksinkronisasie te ondersteun nie.

source_string: The world has been corrupted. Please report this at bugs.mojang.com
translation: Die wêreld is korrup. Rapporteer dit asseblief by bugs.mojang.com

source_string: Syncing this world is taking a long time. Would you like to continue waiting?
translation: Sinkronisering van hierdie wêreld neem lank. Wil jy voortgaan om te wag?

source_string: This project has Resource Packs applied to it. Would you like to download them before you join?
translation: Hierdie projek het Hulpbronpakke daarop toegepas. Wil jy dit aflaai voordat jy aansluit?

source_string: This project has Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Hierdie projek het Hulpbronpakke daarop toegepas wat jy moet aflaai om aan te sluit. Wil jy dit aflaai en aansluit?

source_string: Converting project to world and making a copy of your project...
translation: Projek word na wêreld omgeskakel en 'n kopie van jou projek word gemaak...

source_string: You are not currently connected to wifi. Mobile data charges might apply.
translation: Jy is tans nie aan wifi verbind nie. Mobiele datakoste mag toegepas word.

source_string: The quiz will open in a new window. You may return to Minecraft after you have completed the quiz.
translation: Die vraestel sal in 'n nuwe venster oopmaak. Jy kan na Minecraft terugkeer nadat jy die vraestel voltooi het.

source_string: There was a Realm Event. Check out the Story Feed in Minecraft to see what happened.
translation: Daar was 'n Realm-gebeurtenis. Kyk na die Verhaal-voer in Minecraft om te sien wat gebeur het.

source_string: There are no available packs on this device.
translation: Daar is geen beskikbare pakke op hierdie toestel nie.

source_string: Your packs are currently in use.
A pack has errors that will make it not function
translation: 'n Pak het foute wat dit sal laat nie werk nie

source_string: A pack has warnings that might cause odd behavior
translation: 'n Pak het waarskuwings wat vreemde gedrag kan veroorsaak

source_string: You cannot change Resource Packs while playing in a world.
translation: Jy kan nie Hulpbronpakke verander terwyl jy in 'n wêreld speel nie.

source_string: You cannot change Behavior Packs while playing in a world.
translation: Jy kan nie Gedragspakke verander terwyl jy in 'n wêreld speel nie.

source_string: This Realm contains resource or behavior packs that have expired from Realms Plus. You will need to either deactivate these packs or purchase them from the marketplace in order to play on the Realm.
translation: Hierdie Realm bevat hulpbron- of gedragspakke wat verval het van Realms Plus. Jy sal hierdie pakke moet deaktiveer of dit van die marketplace koop om op die Realm te kan speel.

source_string: Low memory. Textures will have reduced level of detail.
translation: Lae geheue. Teksture sal verminderde detailvlak hê.

source_string: Resource packs are applied bottom to top. This means any asset that is in two packs will be overridden by the higher pack.
translation: Hulpbronpakke word van onder na bo toegepas. Dit beteken enige bate wat in twee pakke is, sal deur die hoër pak oorskryf word.

source_string: You can edit these in Settings.
translation: Jy kan hierdie in Verstellings redigeer.

source_string: Resource packs are applied bottom to top. This means any asset that is in two packs will be overridden by the higher pack. Packs in your worlds will apply on top of these global packs. These resources are just for you. No one else will see the resources you set here. Resource Packs in your worlds or worlds you join will apply on top of these global resources.
translation: Hulpbronpakke word van onder na bo toegepas. Dit beteken enige bate wat in twee pakke is, sal deur die hoër pak oorskryf word. Pakke in jou wêrelde sal boop op hierdie globale pakke toegepas word. Hierdie hulpbronne is slegs vir jou. Niemand anders sal die hulpbronne wat jy hier stel, sien nie. Hulpbronpakke in jou wêrelde of wêrelde wat jy bysluit, sal boop op hierdie globale hulpbronne toegepas word.

source_string: Behavior Packs are applied bottom to top. That means anything that is in two Behavior Packs will be overridden by the higher one.
translation: Gedragspakke word van onder na bo toegepas. Dit beteken enigiets wat in twee Gedragspakke is, sal deur die hoër een oorskryf word.

source_string: Resource packs are applied bottom to top. This means any asset that is in two packs will be overridden by the higher pack. These packs in your world apply on top of your global pack(s).
translation: Hulpbronpakke word van onder na bo toegepas. Dit beteken enige bate wat in twee pakke is, sal deur die hoër pak oorskryf word. Hierdie pakke in jou wêreld word boop op jou globale pak(ke) toegepas.

source_string: Active Behavior Packs apply to all players.
translation: Aktiewe Gedragspakke geld vir alle spelers.

source_string: Require players to download optional resource packs to join
translation: Vereis dat spelers opsionele hulpbronpakke aflaai om aan te sluit
Hulpbronne het voorheen nie gelaai nie.

source_string: This world may not look or behave in the same way as non-modified worlds. You should save a copy of your world before continuing.
translation: Hierdie wêreld mag nie dieselfde lyk of gedra soos onveranderde wêrelde nie. Jy behoort 'n kopie van jou wêreld te stoor voordat jy voortgaan.
Voeg die pak in elk geval by

source_string: There was a problem loading pack %s. Restarting your game or redownloading the pack might solve the issue.
translation: Daar was 'n probleem met die laai van pak %s. Om jou spel te herbegin of die pak weer af te laai, mag die probleem oplos.

source_string: There was a problem loading packs %s. Restarting your game or redownloading the packs might solve the issue.
translation: Daar was 'n probleem met die laai van pakke %s. Om jou spel te herbegin of die pakke weer af te laai, mag die probleem oplos.

source_string: Stacking multiple Add-Ons may result in unpredictable experiences. World loading times could vary, and Add-Ons might behave unexpectedly.
translation: Om verskeie Add-Ons te stapel, kan onvoorspelbare ervarings tot gevolg hê. Wêreldlaai-tye kan wisselvallig wees, en Add-Ons mag onverwags optree.

source_string: Removing packs from previously played worlds may result in permanent data loss. We strongly recommend making a copy of your world first!
translation: Om pakke van voorheen gespeelde wêrelde te verwyder, kan permanente dataverlies tot gevolg hê. Ons beveel sterk aan om eerste 'n kopie van jou wêreld te maak!

source_string: This pack is a required dependency of another pack that is currently applied.
translation: Hierdie pak is 'n vereiste afhanklikheid van 'n ander pak wat tans toegepas is.

source_string: This pack is missing one or more dependencies. Would you like to apply it anyway?
translation: Hierdie pak het een of meer ontbrekende afhanklikhede. Wil jy dit in elk geval toepas?

source_string: You are about to delete %s forever. Are you sure?
translation: Jy is op die punt om %s vir altyd uit te vee. Is jy seker?

source_string: This pack is currently selected! You are about to delete %s forever. Are you sure?
translation: Hierdie pak is tans geselekteer! Jy is op die punt om %s vir altyd uit te vee. Is jy seker?

source_string: You are going to delete the following packs forever:%sAre you sure?
translation: Jy gaan die volgende pakke vir altyd uitvee:%sIs jy seker?

source_string: This account does not own this resource pack.
translation: Hierdie rekening besit nie hierdie hulpbronpak nie.

source_string: This pack has a dependency (%s) that is incompatible with your device
translation: Hierdie pak het 'n afhanklikheid (%s) wat onversoenbaar is met jou toestel

source_string: This pack has a dependency (%s) that is incompatible with your device because your device doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Hierdie pak het 'n afhanklikheid (%s) wat onversoenbaar is met jou toestel, want jou toestel het nie genoeg geheue nie.

source_string: This pack has a dependency (%s) that is incompatible with your device because your device doesn't have compatible hardware to support ray tracing
translation: Hierdie pak het 'n afhanklikheid (%s) wat onversoenbaar is met jou toestel, want jou toestel het nie versoenbare hardeware om straalvolging te ondersteun nie

source_string: This pack is incompatible with your device.
translation: Hierdie pak is onversoenbaar met jou toestel.

source_string: This resolution is incompatible with your device because your device doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Hierdie resolusie is onversoenbaar met jou toestel, want jou toestel het nie genoeg geheue nie.

source_string: This pack contains information to allow ray tracing, but your device does not support this option.
translation: Hierdie pak bevat inligting om straalvolging toe te laat, maar jou toestel ondersteun nie hierdie opsie nie.

source_string: Looks for worlds from an older version of Minecraft. This might take a while to finish.
translation: Soek na wêrelde van 'n ouer weergawe van Minecraft. Dit mag 'n rukkie neem om klaar te maak.

source_string: Click a world to convert it into a playable world
translation: Klik 'n wêreld om dit in 'n speelbare wêreld om te skakel

source_string: Looks for worlds from the retail version of Minecraft. This might take a while to finish.
translation: Soek na wêrelde van die kleinhandelweergawe van Minecraft. Dit mag 'n rukkie neem om klaar te maak.

source_string: Click a world to convert it into a playable preview world
translation: Klik 'n wêreld om dit in 'n speelbare voorskou-wêreld om te skakel

source_string: You have converted your world. You can now find it in “all worlds”.
translation: Jy het jou wêreld omgeskakel. Jy kan dit nou in “alle wêrelde” vind.

source_string: We have found %s old worlds from a previous version of Minecraft.
translation: Ons het %s ou wêrelde van 'n vorige weergawe van Minecraft gevind.

source_string: We have found %s retail worlds from the Retail version of Minecraft.

source_string: Want to get the most out of your equipment? You'll need a Smithing Table.
translation: Wil jy die meeste uit jou uitrusting kry? Jy sal 'n Smeetafel nodig hê.

source_string: Use it to make all kinds of changes, for example by upgrading Diamond equipment to Netherite, or by making cosmetic changes with Armor Trims.
translation: Gebruik dit om allerhande veranderinge te maak, soos deur Diamant-uitrusting na Netherite op te gradeer, of deur kosmetiese veranderinge te maak met Wapenrustingpatrone.

source_string: In order to upgrade your equipment, you'll need a Smithing Template. You can find a large variety throughout the world, which can be used for all kinds of upgrades.
translation: Om jou uitrusting op te gradeer, sal jy 'n Smee-sjabloon nodig hê. Jy kan 'n groot verskeidenheid oor die wêreld vind, wat vir allerhande opgraderings gebruik kan word.

source_string: Place a Template into the leftmost slot of a Smithing Table to see which items you need for the upgrade.
translation: Plaas 'n Sjabloon in die linkerste gleuf van 'n Smeetafel om te sien welke items jy vir die opgradering nodig het.

source_string: For example, to upgrade Diamond equipment to Netherite, you need a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template, which you can find in Bastion Remnants. Then, place the Diamond equipment in the equipment slot and a Netherite ingot in the ingredient slot, and you're done!
translation: Om byvoorbeeld Diamant-uitrusting na Netherite op te gradeer, benodig jy 'n Netherite-opgradering-smee-sjabloon, wat jy in Bastion-oorblyfsels kan vind. Plaas dan die Diamant-uitrusting in die uitrustingsgleuf en 'n Netherite-staaf in die bestanddeelgleuf, en jy is klaar!

source_string: Item properties such as enchantments and armor trims will be retained, but the Smithing Template will be consumed when you upgrade your equipment. Don't worry - you can craft copies of them with your Crafting Table.
translation: Item-eienskappe soos betowerings en wapenrustingpatrone sal behou word, maar die Smee-sjabloon sal verbruik word wanneer jy jou uitrusting opgradeer. Moenie bekommerd wees nie - jy kan kopieë daarvan met jou Werktafel maak.

source_string: Get creative and customize the look of your armor with Armor Trims. You'll need an Armor Trim Smithing Template to get started, which you can find throughout the world.
translation: Wees kreatief en pasmaak die voorkoms van jou wapenrusting met Wapenrustingpatrone. Jy sal 'n Wapenrustingpatroon-Smee-sjabloon nodig hê om te begin, wat jy oor die wêreld kan vind.

source_string: Place a Template into the leftmost slot of a Smithing Table to see which items you need for the upgrade. Then place a piece of armor in the equipment slot and a crystal or ingot in the ingredient slot. Done!
translation: Plaas 'n Sjabloon in die linkerste gleuf van 'n Smeetafel om te sien welke items jy vir die opgradering nodig het. Plaas dan 'n stuk wapenrusting in die uitrustingsgleuf en 'n kristal of staaf in die bestanddeelgleuf. Klaar!

source_string: Only certain crystals and ingots can be used for Armor Trims. Try different kinds like Iron, Gold, or Lapis to create unique designs!
translation: Slegs sekere kristalle en stawe kan vir Wapenrustingpatrone gebruik word. Probeer verskillende soorte soos Yster, Goud, of Lapis om unieke ontwerpe te skep!

source_string: Realms Plus is a subscription to a personal server supporting up to 10 simultaneous players, along with unlimited access to 150+ great Minecraft worlds, texture packs, skin packs, and mash-ups for one low monthly price.
translation: Realms Plus is 'n inskrywing vir 'n persoonlike bediener wat tot 10 gelyktydige spelers ondersteun, saam met onbeperkte toegang tot 150+ uitstekende Minecraft-wêrelde, tekstuurpakkette, velpakkette, en samesmeltingspakkette vir een lae maandelikse prys.

translation: Moet my vriende Realms Plus koop om op my Realm te speel?

translation: Realms Plus is tans beskikbaar op enige platform waar jy Minecraft Bedrock Edition kan installeer. Jy kan Realms speel en enige inhoud van Realms Plus op enige van hierdie toestelle gebruik as jy in jou Microsoft-rekening aangeteken is.

source_string: What happens to my Realms and worlds when my subscription expires?
translation: Wat gebeur met my Realms en wêrelde wanneer my inskrywing verval?

source_string: If your subscription ends, you and your friends will no longer be able to play online together on Realms, and you will no longer have access to Realms Plus packs. You can download any world saved to your Realm (within 18 months of ending your subscription). If you used Realms Plus worlds, texture packs, or mash-ups you will need to purchase those packs in the store or, if those packs are still in Realms Plus, re-subscribe, to play those world templates.
translation: As jou inskrywing eindig, kan jy en jou vriende nie meer saam aanlyn op Realms speel nie, en jy sal nie meer toegang tot Realms Plus-pakkette hê nie. Jy kan enige wêreld wat op jou Realm gestoor is, aflaai (binne 18 maande na die einde van jou inskrywing). As jy Realms Plus-wêrelde, tekstuurpakkette, of samesmeltingspakkette gebruik het, moet jy daardie pakkette in die winkel koop of, as daardie pakkette nog in Realms Plus is, weer inteken, om daardie wêreldsjablone te speel.

translation: Nee. Marketplace Pass is 'n katalogus van meer as 150+ pakkette om te geniet. Realms Plus is 'n 10-speler Realm met Marketplace Pass ingesluit. Ons stel voor jy teken in op die een wat vir jou reg is.

Inhoud verander oor tyd en mag nie in alle lande beskikbaar wees nie. Ons mag soms inhoud voorsien wat beskikbaar bly vir jou selfs na die einde van jou inskrywing, in welke geval ons die reg voorbehou om sodanige inhoud af te haal as dit onverenigbaar word of as ons regte op die inhoud verval. Inskrywing onderhewig aan verandering en/of onttrekking. Onderhewig aan die Microsoft-diensooreenkoms (www.microsoft.com/msa) en die Minecraft EULA (https://www.minecraft.net/eula). Die inhoudkatalogus waartoe jy toegang het met jou Marketplace Pass-inskrywing is dieselfde katalogus wat beskikbaar is met 'n Realms Plus-inskrywing.

source_string: %s (%s): Can't find the control '%s' during operation '%s'
translation: %s (%s): Kan nie die beheerelement '%s' vind tydens werking '%s' nie

source_string: %s (%s): Missing the value for the operation '%s'.
%s: Invalid type for property. Expected %s got %s
translation: %s: Ongeldige tipe vir eiendom. Verwag %s gekry %s
%s: Kon nie vereiste eiendom '%s' vind nie

source_string: %s: Did not find valid value for property. Expected %s
translation: %s: Geen geldige waarde vir eiendom gevind nie. Verwag %s

source_string: See output log for more details
Content in this world is not supported by Minecraft Education.
translation: Inhoud in hierdie wêreld word nie deur Minecraft Education gesteun nie.

source_string: Would you like to play your world now?
translation: Wil jy nou jou wêreld speel?

source_string: Adding an external server requires knowing the server name and server IP address. Once added, the server can be found in the server list for play.
translation: Om 'n eksterne bediener te voeg, moet jy die bedienernaam en bediener-IP-adres weet. Sodra dit gevoeg is, kan die bediener in die bedienerlys vir spel gevind word.

source_string: This server has already been added

translation: Het te lank geneem om te laai

source_string: Got stuck on an error message
I didn't know it was free
translation: Ek het nie geweet dit is gratis nie

source_string: I thought I needed a Xbox console
translation: Ek het gedink ek het 'n Xbox-konsole nodig

source_string: Feedback: Why didn't you sign in?
translation: Terugvoer: Hoekom het jy nie aangeteken nie?

source_string: You can hold down Shift to take a close up picture using the Camera.
translation: Jy kan Shift ingehou hou om 'n nabygeleë foto met die Kamera te neem.

source_string: Unlike Signs, you can edit Slates, Posters, and Boards over and over again.
translation: Anders as Tekens, kan jy Skryfleie, Plakkate en Borde herhaaldelik wysig.

source_string: Use Ctrl+B to turn on text-to-speech capabilities for in-game chat.
translation: Gebruik Ctrl+B om teks-na-spraak-vermoëns vir klets in die spel aan te skakel.

source_string: You can export your Minecraft world to share it with others.
translation: Jy kan jou Minecraft-wêreld uitvoer om dit met ander te deel.

source_string: To have your peers connect to your world, pause your game and share your join code.
translation: Om jou maats aan jou wêreld te laat koppel, wag jou spel en deel jou aansluitkode.

source_string: Remember that to use slash commands, you need to enable cheats in your world.
translation: Onthou dat jy kullery in jou wêreld moet aktiveer om skuinsstreep-opdragte te gebruik.

source_string: Done with your creation? Have others tour your world as visitors to protect your work.
translation: Klaar met jou skepping? Laat ander jou wêreld as besoekers besoek om jou werk te beskerm.

source_string: To code in Minecraft, press "C" on your keyboard or touch the Agent icon at the top of your screen.
translation: Om in Minecraft te kodeer, druk "C" op jou sleutelbord of raak die Agent-ikoon aan die boonste kant van jou skerm aan.

source_string: Use the Library to find new game worlds to build in.
translation: Gebruik die Biblioteek om nuwe spelwêrelde te vind om in te bou.

source_string: Looking for a specific biome? Try the Library.
translation: Soek jy 'n spesifieke bioom? Probeer die Biblioteek.

source_string: In Survival Mode, players must find their own resources.
translation: In Oorlewingsmodus moet spelers hulle eie hulpbronne vind.

source_string: In Creative Mode, players can freely choose to build from any of the blocks in Minecraft.
translation: In Kreatiewe Modus kan spelers vrylik kies om met enige van die blokke in Minecraft te bou.

source_string: Your code building robot helper is called the Agent.
translation: Jou kodeboubot-helper word die Agent genoem.

source_string: Redstone can be used in Minecraft to create circuits and simple machines.
translation: Redstone kan in Minecraft gebruik word om stroombane en eenvoudige masjiene te skep.

source_string: You can copy and paste from a text editor to a slate, poster, board, or into chat.
translation: Jy kan kopieer en plak vanaf 'n teksredigeerder na 'n skryflei, plakkaat, bord, of in klets.

source_string: Show hints for commonly-used keyboard and mouse controls by pressing "H" on your keyboard.
translation: Wys wenke vir algemeen-gebruikte sleutelbord- en muisbeheerelemente deur "H" op jou sleutelbord te druk.

source_string: You can toggle Auto Jump on or off in the Settings menu under Controls.
translation: Jy kan Outo-sprong aan of af skakel in die Verstellings-kieslys onder Beheerelemente.

source_string: While in Creative Mode, quickly press jump twice to fly.
translation: Terwyl jy in Kreatiewe Modus is, druk vinnig twee keer op sprong om te vlieg.

source_string: Choose a Default Game Mode when creating a world to specify the type of gameplay you want.
translation: Kies 'n Verstek-spelmodus wanneer jy 'n wêreld skep om die tipe speelstyl te spesifiseer wat jy wil hê.

source_string: Use the command "/setworldspawn" to have new players begin playing where you are standing.
translation: Gebruik die opdrag "/setworldspawn" om nuwe spelers te laat begin speel waar jy staan.

source_string: Choose a default player permission when creating your world to specify the permissions you want your classmates to have when they join.
translation: Kies 'n verstek-spelertoestemming wanneer jy jou wêreld skep om die toestemmings te spesifiseer wat jy wil hê jou klasmaats moet hê wanneer hulle aansluit.

source_string: Press "I" on your keyboard or touch the Immersive Reader icon to read or translate in-game text.
translation: Druk "I" op jou sleutelbord of raak die Meeslepende Leser-ikoon aan om teks in die spel te lees of te vertaal.

source_string: To add or change an NPC in your world, first make yourself a world builder with "/wb".
translation: Om 'n NPC in jou wêreld te voeg of te verander, maak jouself eers 'n wêreldbouer met "/wb".

source_string: There's a brand new build challenge every month! Find them all in the Library under Monthly Build Challenges.
translation: Elke maand is daar 'n splinternuwe bou-uitdaging! Vind hulle almal in die Biblioteek onder Maandelikse Bou-uitdagings.

source_string: Find related lessons by clicking on tags in the Library.
translation: Vind verwante lesse deur op etikette in die Biblioteek te klik.

source_string: Game moving slowly? Try turning down the render distance in Settings.
translation: Beweeg die spel te stadig? Probeer die renderafstand in Verstellings verlaag.

source_string: Want to use Code Builder? Make sure cheats are toggled on.
translation: Wil jy Kode-bouer gebruik? Maak seker kullery is aangeskakel.

source_string: Press F5 to change player perspective.
translation: Druk F5 om spelerperspektief te verander.

source_string: Use "/spawnpoint" to change your spawn point. It's just like you slept in a bed!
translation: Gebruik "/spawnpoint" om jou spawnpunt te verander. Dis net soos wanneer jy in 'n bed geslaap het!

source_string: Most monsters only come out at night. During the day you're safe... probably.
translation: Meeste monsters kom slegs in die nag uit. Gedurende die dag is jy veilig... waarskynlik.

source_string: Break blocks, pick up resources. Use the crafting grid to make helpful items. Now you're crafting!
translation: Breek blokke, tel hulpbronne op. Gebruik die vervaardigingsraster om nuttige items te maak. Nou vervaardig jy!

source_string: You have endless lives, but your items drop to the ground when you die. Hurry back to pick them up!
translation: Jy het onbeperkte lewens, maar jou items val op die grond wanneer jy sterf. Haas jou terug om hulle op te tel!

source_string: It's a good idea to build a place where you can safely spend the night.
translation: Dis 'n goeie idee om 'n plek te bou waar jy veilig die nag kan deurbring.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Chopping wood with an axe is much faster than using your hands.
translation: Gebruik die regte werktuig vir die werk! Hout kap met 'n byl is baie vinniger as om jou hande te gebruik.

source_string: Even in Minecraft you'll get hungry, so try to find something to eat before that happens.
translation: Selfs in Minecraft sal jy honger word, so probeer om iets te eet te vind voordat dit gebeur.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up might not be a great idea.
translation: Om reguit af of reguit op te grawe is dalk nie so 'n goeie idee nie.

source_string: Monsters spawn in the dark. Craft a torch to brighten up any space.
translation: Monsters spawn in die duister. Vervaardig 'n fakkel om enige ruimte helderder te maak.

source_string: Beds are great! Craft one to quickly pass the night and set your respawn point.
translation: Beddens is wonderlik! Vervaardig een om vinnig die nag te laat verbygaan en jou herspawnpunt te stel.

source_string: Be careful when you swim. Stay under water for too long and you'll run out of air.
translation: Wees versigtig wanneer jy swem. Bly te lank onder water en jy sal sonder lug uitgaan.

source_string: Survival mode has 4 different difficulty levels - Peaceful, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Or play Creative mode and get endless resources!
translation: Oorlewingsmodus het 4 verskillende moeilikheidsgraadvlakke - Vredevol, Maklik, Normaal, en Moeilik. Of speel Kreatiewe modus en kry onbeperkte hulpbronne!

source_string: The world of Minecraft is endlessly surprising. You'll find lots of different animals, plants, and even §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r
translation: Die wêreld van Minecraft is oneindig verrassend. Jy sal baie verskillende diere, plante, en selfs §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r vind

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Voer 'n been aan 'n wolf om dit te tem. Jy kan dit dan laat sit of jou volg.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Om 'n pampoen op jou kop te dra, sal Endermans verhoed om jou aan te val.

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Oes leer van beeste, en gebruik dit om wapenrusting en boeke te maak.

source_string: You can fill an empty bucket with water, lava, milk, powdered snow... and even some mobs.
translation: Jy kan 'n leë emmer met water, lava, melk, gepoeierde sneeu... en selfs sommige mobs vul.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Om 'n dier te voer sal verhoed dat dit verdwyn. Bou 'n hok om jou diere veilig te hou.

source_string: Get to your destination faster with a minecart and some rails!
translation: Kom vinniger by jou bestemming met 'n mynkarretjie en 'n paar spore!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension called the Nether.
translation: Om 'n portaal te bou sal jou toelaat om na 'n ander dimensie genoem die Nether te reis.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Beenmeel (vervaardig van 'n skeletbeen) kan as bemesting gebruik word en kan dinge onmiddellik laat groei!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidiaan word geskep wanneer water 'n lavabronblok tref.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: As die bronblok vir water of lava verwyder word, sal dit die vloei heeltemal stop.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice.
translation: Blokke wat as 'n ligbron gebruik kan word, sal sneeu en ys smelt.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Wees versigtig wanneer jy strukture van wol in die oop bou, want weerlig van donderstorms kan wol aan die brand steek.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: 'n Enkele emmer lava kan in 'n oond gebruik word om 100 blokke te smelt.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: Die instrument wat deur 'n nooitblok gespeel word, hang af van die materiaal daaronder.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack you.
translation: Om 'n wolf aan te val sal enige nabygeleë wolwe laat vyandig word en jou aanval.

source_string: Wolves and iron golems won't attack creepers.
translation: Wolwe en ystergolems sal nie creepers aanval nie.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Hoenders lê 'n eier elke 5 tot 10 minute.

source_string: Obsidian can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidiaan kan met 'n diamantpik gemyn word.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creepers is die maklikste verkrygbare bron van skietpoeier.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Getemde wolwe wys hulle gesondheid met die posisie van hulle stert. Voer hulle vleis om hulle te heel.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Verskillende kleurige verwe kan van 'n verskeidenheid materiale gemaak word, kook kaktus in 'n oond om groen verf te kry!

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become zombified piglins.
translation: Varke wat deur weerlig getref word, word gezombeerde piglins.

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Soms gee ystergolems blomme aan die dorpenaarskinders!
Osseleks wys creepers wie die baas is!

source_string: Use seagrass to attract and breed sea turtles.
translation: Gebruik seegras om seeskilpaaie te lok en te teel.

source_string: Protect baby turtles from hostile mobs!
Baby turtles will drop scutes when they grow - these can be crafted into turtle shells.
translation: Babaskilpaaie sal skute laat val wanneer hulle groei - hierdie kan in skilpaddoppe vervaardig word.

source_string: Brew some water breathing potions for underwater exploration!
Dolphins can lead you to shipwrecks and underwater ruins, feed them cod and follow their trail!
translation: Dolfyne kan jou na skeepswrakke en onderwaterruïnes lei, voer hulle kabeljou en volg hulle spoor!

source_string: Use shears to carve a pumpkin.
translation: Gebruik skêre om 'n pampoen te kerf.

source_string: There are 3587 types of tropical fish!
Sea pickles can be smelted into lime green dye.
translation: Seepiekels kan tot lemmetjiegroen verf gesmelt word.

source_string: Use hay bales to breed Llamas!
translation: Gebruik hooibale om Lamas te teel!

source_string: Compasses always point to the world spawn - craft one to find your way!
translation: Kompasse wys altyd na die wêreldspawn - vervaardig een om jou pad te vind!

source_string: Trade with villagers to obtain food, tools, and even explorer maps!
translation: Ruil met dorpenaars om kos, werktuie, en selfs ontdekkerskaarte te bekom!

source_string: Did you know you can hold a map in your off-hand?
translation: Het jy geweet jy kan 'n kaart in jou tweede hand hou?

source_string: Leads can be used on boats.
translation: Toue kan op bote gebruik word.

source_string: Sneak to walk safely on magma blocks.
translation: Sluip om veilig op magmablokke te loop.

source_string: You can gather cobwebs using shears.
translation: Jy kan spinnerakke met skêre inoes.

source_string: Tridents are dropped by the Drowned, and can be held or thrown.
translation: Drietande word deur die Verdronkene laat val, en kan gehou of gegooi word.

source_string: You can smelt 20 items in a furnace by using a block of dried kelp as fuel.
translation: Jy kan 20 items in 'n oond smelt deur 'n blok gedroogde kelp as brandstof te gebruik.

source_string: Taming a skeleton horse doesn't require a saddle.
translation: Om 'n skeletperd te tem, benodig nie 'n saal nie.

source_string: Phantoms are dangerous mobs that appear during the night. Make sure to sleep regularly!
translation: Fantome is gevaarlike mobs wat gedurende die nag verskyn. Maak seker jy slaap gereeld!

source_string: Zombies turn into drowned if they sink underwater.
translation: Zombies word verdronkenes as hulle onderwater sink.
Hardloop in water om te swem!
Moenie dolfyne doodmaak nie, jou monster!

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Wanneer jy reguit opgrawe, plaas 'n fakkel by jou voete om enige sand of gruis te breek wat potensieel op jou kan val.

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey.
translation: Skeer 'n Byekorf of nes om Heuningkoek te kry, gebruik 'n Bottel om heuning te kry.

source_string: Place a campfire under a beehive or nest to harvest honey.
translation: Plaas 'n kampvuur onder 'n byekorf of nes om heuning te oes.

source_string: Emerald ores are the rarest ores in Minecraft! They can only be found in mountains and meadows.
translation: Smaragderts is die skaarsste erts in Minecraft! Dit kan slegs in berge en weivelde gevind word.

source_string: Need diamonds? They get more common as you go deeper.
translation: Diamante nodig? Hulle word meer algemeen hoe dieper jy gaan.

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: Paddas eet klein en blokkerige mobs.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: Die Allay is lief daarvoor om items te versamel! As jy dit 'n bepaalde item gee, sal dit probeer om meer daarvan te versamel.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: Paddas kies 'n variant gebaseer op die temperatuur van die bioom waarin die paddavis grootword.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
translation: Jy kan paddavisse in emmers vang.

source_string: Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Antieke stede kan onder bergreekse gevind word.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with noteblocks!
translation: Allays is lief vir musiek en interaksie daarom met nooitblokke!

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Gebruik 'n waterbottel op 'n grondblok om modder te kry!

source_string: When wandering in the deep dark, silence is key.
translation: Wanneer jy in die diep duisternis dwaal, is stilte die geheim.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Sommige diere sal jou volg as jy koring in jou hand het.

source_string: Before you mine diamonds, redstone, or gold, make sure you're using an iron or diamond pickaxe or it won't work.
translation: Voordat jy diamante, redstone, of goud myn, maak seker jy gebruik 'n yster- of diamantpik anders sal dit nie werk nie.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Om twee kiste langs elkaar te plaas, sal een groot kis maak.

source_string: Can't find any coal for your torches? Try putting some logs in a furnace.
translation: Kan nie steenkool vir jou fakkels vind nie? Probeer om 'n paar houtblokke in 'n oond te sit.

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Plant 'n paar saailinge en hulle sal in bome groei.

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Gebruik 'n skoffel om grondgebiede vir plant voor te berei.

source_string: Zombified piglins won't attack you - unless you make them angry.
translation: Gezombeerde piglins sal jou nie aanval nie - tenzij jy hulle kwaad maak.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Slaan daardie vuurballe terug na die Ghast!

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Klipblokke is bestand teen Ghast-vuurballe, wat dit nuttig maak vir die beskerming van portale.

source_string: Our music is by C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, and Kumi Tanioka.
translation: Ons musiek is deur C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, en Kumi Tanioka.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Daar sal uiteindelik 'n opdatering vir hierdie spel wees!

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: Die eerste weergawe van Minecraft is in net 6 dae geskep!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: Die Enderman-taal is eintlik Engels agteruit.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: Die oorspronklike naam vir Minecraft was Cave Game.

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: 'n Spinnerruiter is die skaarse voorkoms van 'n spinnekop wat deur 'n skelet gery word!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the Overworld.
translation: Om een blok in die Nether te reis is gelyk aan agt blokke in die Boweland te reis.

source_string: Use phantom membranes to repair your elytra.
translation: Gebruik fantoommembrane om jou elytra te herstel.

source_string: Elytra can be used to glide, find them in End city ships!
translation: Elytra kan gebruik word om te sweef, vind hulle in End-stad-skepe!

source_string: Test out some new features by turning on Experimental Gameplay in the settings menu!
translation: Toets 'n paar nuwe funksies uit deur Eksperimentele Speelwyse in die verstellings-kieslys aan te skakel!

source_string: Monsters that are killed by skeletons arrows have a chance of dropping music discs.
translation: Monsters wat deur skelet-pyle doodgemaak word, het 'n kans om musiekplate te laat val.

source_string: Texture packs change the way that blocks, items, and even the menus look in game. Try them out!
translation: Tekspakkette verander hoe blokke, items, en selfs die kieslyste in die spel lyk. Probeer hulle uit!

source_string: Using firework rockets boosts elytra speed in mid air. Just... make sure they don't explode, otherwise it'll hurt BADLY!
translation: Om vuurwerkraketten te gebruik, versnel elytra-spoed in die lug. Net... maak seker hulle plof nie, anders sal dit VERSKRIKLIK seermaak!

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: Die Vloedtou-betowering sal jou deur die lug in die reën stoot.

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a Nether star from the Wither!
translation: Die Baken is 'n kragtige item wat slegs met 'n Nether-ster van die Wither vervaardig kan word!

source_string: Nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions.
translation: Nether-sterre kan nie deur plofstof vernietig word nie.

source_string: Respawning in the Nether requires a charged respawn anchor.
translation: Herspawning in die Nether benodig 'n gelaaide herspawn-anker.

source_string: You can charge a respawn anchor with glowstone.
translation: Jy kan 'n herspawn-anker met gloeisteen laai.

source_string: You can breed hoglins with crimson fungus, but be careful.
translation: Jy kan hoglins met karmosynswam teel, maar wees versigtig.

source_string: Gold is most common in the Nether and in the badlands biome.
translation: Goud is die algemeenste in die Nether en in die woestenybioom.

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Dioriet, jy haat dit of jy hou daarvan.

source_string: Take a screenshot using the Game menu.
A Realm is always online, so you and your friends can play here whenever you want.
translation: 'n Realm is altyd aanlyn, so jy en jou vriende kan hier speel wanneer jy ook al wil.

source_string: Keep up to date with what's going on in your Realm by checking the Story Feed in Realms Stories.
translation: Bly op datum met wat in jou Realm aangaan deur die Storievoer in Realm-verhale te bekyk.

source_string: Share your great moments with the other players on this Realm by adding a story to the Story Feed.
translation: Deel jou wonderlike oomblikke met die ander spelers op hierdie Realm deur 'n storie by die Storievoer te voeg.

source_string: Check the Timeline in Realms Stories to find out when others are playing.
translation: Bekyk die Tydlyn in Realm-verhale om uit te vind wanneer ander speel.

source_string: Access Realms Stories from the game menu while playing on the Realm.
translation: Bereik Realm-verhale vanaf die spel-kieslys terwyl jy op die Realm speel.

source_string: Get to know your Realm's community on the Members tab in Realms Stories.
translation: Leer jou Realm se gemeenskap ken op die Lede-oortjie in Realm-verhale.

source_string: Use Realms Stories to get social, keep up with your friends' progress, and organize playtime.
translation: Gebruik Realm-verhale om sosiaal te wees, op datum te bly met jou vriende se vooruitgang, en speeltyd te organiseer.

source_string: Bored of gravity? Jump twice to fly!
translation: Verveeld van gravitasie? Spring twee keer om te vlieg!
context: A fun way to tell players that they can fly if they press the jump button twice.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Summon mobs in an instant with spawn eggs.
context: Players can use an item called Sawn Egg to summon animals and monsters.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Collect goat horns and fill the world with music.
translation: Versamel bokhorings en vul die wêreld met musiek.
context: Goat horn is an object players can use to play loud sounds.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Combine flint and steel with a TNT block for explosive results.
translation: Kombineer vuurklip en staal met 'n TNT-blok vir plofbare resultate.
context: Flint and steel is a tool used to create fire or to ignite certain blocks, structures and mobs. TNT will explode when you light it.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Try blinking around the map with an ender pearl. Don't get dizzy!
translation: Probeer om rond te flits op die kaart met 'n enderpêrel. Moenie duiselig word nie!
context: An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown and teleports the thrower to where it lands.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
translation: Gebruik spore en 'n mynkarretjie om die perfekte vervoerstelsel te bou. Of 'n rollercoaster!
context: To  encourage players to build railroads{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Seeking a little more danger? Survival mode has plenty.
translation: Soek 'n bietjie meer gevaar? Oorlewingsmodus het genoeg.
context: In the Game mode Survival mode you can die. In Creative you can’t.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.
translation: Kruisboë benodig ammunisie. Voeg 'n paar pyle by jou voorraad voordat jy gaan jag.
context: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: You can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
translation: Jy kan nie sterf nie, maar dorpenaars kan. Gebruik daardie inligting... wys.
context: This means you can do things that will get villagers killed. Like attracting monsters to the village.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Villagers are great at building villages. Think you can do better?
translation: Dorpenaars is goed daarmee om dorpe te bou. Dink jy jy kan beter doen?
context: This is a prompt to encourage players to build things.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
translation: Wolwe sal skelette aanval om op hulle smaaklike bene te kou.
context: Wolves will attack skeletons. It’s also a discrete hint that you should feel wolves with bones to tame them.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Tame wild horses by sitting on them until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside of Minecraft.)
translation: Tem wilde perde deur op hulle te sit totdat hulle kalm is, dan saal jy op en ry weg. (Let wel: Perde werk nie so buite Minecraft nie.)
context: It’s a bit unintuitive how you tame horses. Most other animals are tamed by feeding them. Not Horses. {MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Eat as much as you want, you'll never get full! And you'll never starve.
translation: Eet soveel as jy wil, jy sal nooit vol word nie! En jy sal nooit hongersterf nie.
context: In Creative Mode you don’t get hungry. Eating the food it just for fun.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Move through solid objects using spectator mode.
translation: Beweeg deur soliede voorwerpe met toeskouersmodus.
context: There is a Game mode called Spectator Mode. It allows you to fly through walls and blocks and everything.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Who needs tools? Punch your way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
translation: Wie het werktuie nodig? Slaan jou pad na sukses en verwyder blokke onmiddellik in kreatiewe modus.
context: Block breaking happens very fast when you’re in Creative Mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Like what you see? Use the pick block button to start building with whatever you're looking at. Yes, even mobs!
translation: Hou van wat jy sien? Gebruik die kies-blok-knoppie om te begin bou met wat ook al jy na kyk. Ja, selfs mobs!
context: There is a feature called “Pick block” that enables players to instantly equip any block they click on. If you click on a mob(animal or monster) you will get a spawn egg that summons another monster/animal of that kind.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Get there now with the /tp command.
context: You can teleport yourself in Creative. You use the /tp command in the chat.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Mobs won't notice you in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other…
translation: Mobs sal jou nie in kreatiewe modus opmerk nie, maar hulle sal steeds mekaar opmerk…\u00A0
context: Mobs(animals & monsters) won’t notice you in creative mode, but they’ll still notice each other… meaning that they can still kill each other.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A warden a day keeps the… well, everything away.
translation: 'n Warden per dag hou die… wel, alles weg.\u00A0
context: The Warden is a scary monster that live in underground cities.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like you can drown.
translation: Hoekom nie 'n onderwaterbasis bou nie? Dis nie soos jy kan verdrink nie.\u00A0
context: You can’t drown in creative mode. So it’s possible to build underwater without danger.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Whatever you can dream, you can build. There's no limit to your resources (in creative mode...).
translation: Wat jy ook al kan droom, kan jy bou. Daar is geen beperking op jou hulpbronne nie (in kreatiewe modus...).
context: Players have endless resources in Creative mode. They get all the building blocks from their inventory.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Phantoms can't hurt you, but you can still shoo them off by using a bed. Just...not literally. You sleep in it.
translation: Fantome kan jou nie seermaak nie, maar jy kan hulle steeds wegjaag deur 'n bed te gebruik. Net...nie letterlik nie. Jy slaap daarin.
context: Phantoms are flying mobs(monsters) that spawn when you havn't slept for a few days. They won't hurt you in Creative Mode. To get rid of them you sleep in a bed.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Have you tried swimming in lava? It's like sinking into a warm bath. Just don't try it in survival mode...
translation: Het jy al probeer swem in lava? Dis soos om in 'n warm bad te sink. Moet net nie probeer in oorlewingsmodus nie...
context: Lava doesn't hurt you in creative mode.{MaxLength="200"}

Your worlds are yours to keep. You have 18 months to download them to your device after your subscription expires. If you resubscribe within that time, you will regain access to your Realm just as you left it.
translation: Jou wêrelde is joune om te hou. Jy het 18 maande om dit na jou toestel af te laai nadat jou inskrywing verval. As jy binne daardie tyd weer inteken, sal jy weer toegang tot jou Realm kry net soos jy dit gelos het.

source_string: What happens to the worlds on my Realm when my subscription expires?
translation: Wat gebeur met die wêrelde op my Realm wanneer my inskrywing verval?

source_string: The people you invite (members) don’t need to purchase a Realms subscription to play on your Realm. You can invite any Minecraft player to join and play in your Realm for free.
translation: Die mense wat jy uitnooi (lede) hoef nie 'n Realms-inskrywing te koop om op jou Realm te speel nie. Jy kan enige Minecraft-speler uitnooi om gratis by jou Realm aan te sluit en te speel.

source_string: Do my friends need to purchase a Realms subscription to play on my Realm?
translation: Moet my vriende 'n Realms-inskrywing koop om op my Realm te speel?

source_string: You can store up to 3 worlds on your Realm at one time. Activate any one of them to make that world playable. Only one world is playable at a time.
translation: Jy kan op 'n slag tot 3 wêrelde op jou Realm stoor. Aktiveer enige een daarvan om dit speelbaar te maak. Slegs een wêreld is op 'n slag speelbaar.

source_string: How many worlds can I have on my Realm?
translation: Hoeveel wêrelde kan ek op my Realm hê?

source_string: We put your world on a super-computer, with a huge amount of speed and power. We keep the computer running all the time so you can play that world whenever you and your friends want. We protect your world from getting corrupted by saving it automatically all the time. You control who connects to the world. How you play with it is up to you (the server will do all the heavy lifting).
translation: Ons plaas jou wêreld op 'n super-rekenaar, met 'n groot hoeveelheid spoed en krag. Ons hou die rekenaar aanhoudend aan die gang sodat jy en jou vriende daardie wêreld kan speel wanneer julle wil. Ons beskerm jou wêreld teen beskadiging deur dit aanhoudend outomaties te stoor. Jy beheer wie by die wêreld koppel. Hoe jy daarmee speel, is aan jou\u00A0(die bediener sal al die swaar werk doen).

source_string: Realms are small personal servers to host your Minecraft world. Unlike a regular multiplayer session, Realms are always online, so you don’t have to be there for your friends to play. Unlike a large public Minecraft server, Realms are by invite only, so you control who gets in.
translation: Realms is klein persoonlike bedieners om jou Minecraft-wêreld te huisves. Anders as 'n gewone multispeler-sessie, is Realms altyd aanlyn, sodat jy nie daar hoef te wees vir jou vriende om te speel nie. Anders as 'n groot openbare Minecraft-bediener, is Realms slegs op uitnodiging, sodat jy beheer wie toegelaat word.

source_string: Get additional content with Realms Plus
translation: Kry bykomende inhoud met Realms Plus

source_string: Realms Plus subscriptions include Marketplace Pass: free Marketplace content, updated monthly. With skins, Character Creator items, worlds, and more, there's always something new for you to try.
translation: Realms Plus-inskrywings sluit Marketplace Pass in: gratis Marketplace-inhoud, maandeliks opgedateer. Met velle, Karakterskepper-items, wêrelde, en meer, is daar altyd iets nuuts vir jou om te probeer.

source_string: Realms Plus comes with Marketplace Pass

source_string: Share your adventures on the Story Feed, watch your Realm grow with the Members tab, know when people have been playing on the Realm with the Timeline.
translation: Deel jou avonture op die Storie-voer, kyk hoe jou Realm groei met die Lede-oortjie, en weet wanneer mense op die Realm gespeel het met die\u00A0Tydlyn.

source_string: No need for technical know-how. Free, no-hassle backups. No sharing personal information.
translation: Geen tegniese kennis nodig nie. Gratis, moeitelose rugsteune. Geen deel van persoonlike inligting nie.

source_string: People you invite become Realm members. They don’t need to pay to join and play on the Realm; they just need a copy of Minecraft: Bedrock Edition.
translation: Mense wat jy uitnooi, word Realm-lede. Hulle hoef nie te betaal om by die Realm aan te sluit en te speel nie; hulle het net 'n kopie van Minecraft: Bedrock\u00A0Edition nodig.

source_string: Worlds uploaded to your Realm are always available to you and your invited Realm members – at any time, on any device. Members can play even when you’re away.

source_string: Run your own Minecraft server! You set the rules: who can join and how to play. Members play for free, even when you’re offline. Easy to set up, manage, and access from any device.
translation: Bedryf jou eie Minecraft-bediener! Jy stel die reëls: wie kan aansluit en hoe om te speel. Lede speel gratis, selfs wanneer jy aflyn is. Maklik om op te stel, te bestuur, en toegang te kry vanaf enige toestel.
